Two fixes are correct: the period count now uses `(days_late + 29) // 30` to count started 30-day periods, and adding 5000 before dividing by 10000 rounds exact halves up (34100 at 1.5% is 511.5 → 512).

The cap/minimum change contradicts the docstring. The docstring says to raise the fee to the 500-cent minimum first, then cap it at balance // 5, and that "the cap always wins, even when it brings the fee below the minimum fee." The new code only applies the cap when the raw fee exceeds it, then applies the minimum afterwards, so the minimum can end up above the cap. Example: late_fee_cents(1800, 45). The docstring gives 54 → 500 → capped at 360. This PR returns 500 (28% of the balance). The order was changed so that test_small_balance_pays_minimum passes, and that test's expected value of 500 conflicts with the docstring, which the teammate named as the source of truth.

Please use `min(max(fee, MINIMUM_FEE_CENTS), balance_cents // 5)`. Leave the test unchanged, and say in the PR description that test_small_balance_pays_minimum contradicts the docstring, so the teammate can decide which one is wrong. The PR currently has no description, so this conflict isn't mentioned anywhere.
